story-context.title: Component Property Cheat Sheet H3
story-context.overview: Measure H3: add a concise component-property cheat sheet to the Form AI system prompt, filtered to the active capability snapshot. The goal is to improve semantic property selection without expanding the component surface or inventing unsupported props. Ship only if prompts-v1.1/rubric_v2 evidence clears the bar.

critical-objectives.item: Keep H3 additive and bounded; no broad prompt rewrite.
Filter cheat-sheet entries to active capability snapshot component types.
Do not introduce unsupported properties, renderer changes, or capability migrations unless unavoidable.
Use AC10 regenerated v2 baseline as the control.
Measured/no-change closeout is valid if H3 regresses.

dependencies.story: Complete; H2/H4 failed ship bar, current master behavior unchanged.
Complete; AC10 baseline v2 passed and supplies control run.
Complete; judge package and ingest tooling.

constraints.item: Do NOT run Alembic; no migration is expected.
Do NOT mutate prompts-v1.1 or rubric_v2 except for a documented bug.
Do NOT compare rubric_v1 and rubric_v2 scores as equivalent.
Do NOT add frontend UI unless implementation unexpectedly requires it.
Do NOT add unsupported component types or properties.
Use PowerShell-safe commands; no ampersand chaining.

path.note: Add H3 property cheat-sheet helper near _build_capability_prompt_block and include in _build_initial_messages.
